I bailed at t=6m rather than waiting for further confirmation since a full round-trip of a strong favorable excursion into a fresh adverse extreme is the wrong-direction signature, not a normal dip. Next time I'd watch for the round-trip-through-breakeven moment itself (frame 4) as an earlier warning rather than waiting for the loss to double.
